objectives.text: Retrieve, without notes, the collection, operation cost and equality rule that fit a described scenario
Rewrite a loop that filters, transforms and groups data as an equivalent stream pipeline, and rewrite a stream pipeline as a loop
Diagnose a collection or stream bug from its symptom: a missing hashCode, a ConcurrentModificationException, a reused stream or an unchecked Optional.get

minutes.basis: intake planning estimate under the new-course rule in workflow/docs/tools/validators.md (budget at least ceil(max(estimator P50, modeledWorstPath)), 15-minute ceiling, no day-pool shares). Planned page: a review page of retrieval prompts and diagnosis checks. modeledP50 8 is the planned estimator P50 and modeledWorstPath 10 the planned worst required route (two wrong graded attempts and wrong-first explores per interactive unit); no artifact.html exists yet, so the lambdas-and-streams module PR re-measures both with the frozen workflow/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py on the authored bytes and raises budget and aboutLabel if the measured minimum is higher. See workflow/evidence/collections-streams/intake.md, section Minute budgets.
